partition_policy.freeze_rule: Do not move parameter, wrapper, or revision variants of this root cause into a development set, and do not tune ranking weights after observing controlled-v1 outcomes.

pairs.relationship: The fixed revision is a merge commit whose first parent is the vulnerable revision; both exact file versions are frozen below.

public_defect.title: Subtract uses an unconstrained multiplier d
public_defect.description: The vulnerable template assigns d <-- 1 without constraining d and only constrains c = (a-b)*d, so the R1CS does not bind c to subtraction.
public_defect.fix_description: The fixed template removes d and constrains c <== a-b.

component_contract.wrapper_scope: Minimal direct wrapper: include the frozen subtractTensor.circom and instantiate component main = Subtract(); no added constraints or conversions.

input_preconditions.statement: a and b are canonical BN128 scalar-field elements; no additional integer range precondition is imposed.
input_preconditions.basis: Circom signal field semantics and the template interface. The reviewed property is field subtraction, not bounded signed/unsigned integer subtraction.

predeclared_property.statement: For every satisfying assignment, c = a - b modulo the BN128 scalar field prime.
predeclared_property.violation_rule: A candidate violates the property only when it satisfies every constraint of the selected frozen target and c != a-b mod p while the input preconditions hold.

valid_original_component_finding_require: all constraints of the selected frozen component revision satisfied
